questions.question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

Bushfire have created havoc and exacerbated the conditions of animals in the forest.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **error is in **the part: "Bushfire have created havoc"
 
• The **correct form** should be "Bushfires have created havoc".
 
• In English, **subject-verb agreement** is a grammatical rule which states that the subject and verb must agree in number.
 
• That means, if the subject is plural, the verb must be plural.
 
• Conversely, if the **subject is singular, the verb must be singular.**
 
• In this case, **"Bushfire" **is a singular noun, but **"have" **is a plural verb, so they don't agree in number.
 
• The **sentence should be corrected by** changing "Bushfire" to the plural form "Bushfires" to match the plural verb "have".

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'Bushfires have created havoc and exacerbated the conditions of animals in the forest.'*

• When two subjects are connected with 'as well as, with, along with, together with, in addition to, except, rather than, accompanied by, nothing but, etc.',* *then the helping verb should be used according to the first subject of the sentence.
 
• Example:
 
 
• *The Captain along with the sailors were drowned. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b91b169c9a6aba309887b5e1410c56688829831001bc1448ed23f1bec5eca1d8.png] *

questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, then select the option "No error".**

We talked about writing a will, but it/ was one of those thing you never/ get around to doing.

options.text: was one of those thing you never
We talked about writing a will, but it

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **segment** of the sentence **that contains a grammatical error** is *"was one of those thing you never".*
 
• In the phrase** "one of those things"**, the word **"things"** should be** plural **because "one of" is referring to any one member of a group or category.
 
• The **group or category** (in this case, "things") is always **plural** in this construction.

Therefore, the correct sentence should be:* "We talked about writing a will, but it** was one of those things you never** get around to doing."*

questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The police arrested / two young men / but neither of them were / responsible for the robbery.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'but neither of them were'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'but neither of them was**' should be used instead of** 'but neither of them were'.**
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is as follows:
 
• Neither of+Plural Noun/Pronoun+Singular Verb.
 
 
• Example: *Neither of them looks after him.*
 
 
 
• Hence, '**was**' should be used.
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is** Option 2**.

 

**Correct Answer:__*** The police arrested two young men but **neither of them was **responsible for the robbery.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहाँ, **'but neither of them were' **के स्थान पर** 'but neither of them was' **का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• इस प्रकार के वाक्यों की संरचना इस प्रकार है:
 
• Neither of+Plural Noun/Pronoun+Singular Verb.
 
 
• Example: *Neither of them looks after him.*
 
 
 
• इसलिए, '**was**' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर** विकल्प 2** है।
